name: Taksh Mehta
headline: Mechanical Engineering Student | Aspiring Builder
intro: I'm Taksh Mehta. I'm currently building HabitLens while exploring ideas in engineering and technology.
about: I'm a Mechanical Engineering student at CHARUSAT who enjoys understanding how things work and turning ideas into practical projects.
I learn by experimenting, building, testing, and improving. I'm developing my skills in programming, mechanical design, and electronics.
My long-term ambition is to build a business around technology and engineering. For now, I'm focused on learning, creating, and gaining practical experience.
